item.title: Trongsa
item.description: Trongsa, located at the geographic heart of Bhutan Trongsa is a small but historically significant town located in central Bhutan. It lies in a dramatic mountainous region and has played a vital role in shaping the country’s political and cultural history. The town is regarded as the ancestral home of Bhutan’s royal family. Strategic location Trongsa occupies a strategic position at the geographic center of Bhutan. Historically, it controlled the main trade routes between eastern and western Bhutan, making it crucial for maintaining national unity.
